workObjects.name: Product
workObjects.description: A physical or digital item that can be bought, sold, or managed within the system

workObjects.name: Order
workObjects.description: A formal request to purchase one or more products, tracked through its lifecycle

workObjects.name: Invoice
workObjects.description: A financial document issued to a customer detailing amounts owed for products or services

workObjects.name: Payment
workObjects.description: A monetary transaction that settles all or part of an outstanding invoice

workObjects.name: Inventory
workObjects.description: The current stock levels and location of all products held by the organisation

actors.name: Customer
actors.description: End user who browses, orders, and tracks purchases through the system

actors.name: Administrator
actors.description: Internal user with elevated privileges to manage configuration and override business rules

actors.name: System
actors.description: Automated process that executes scheduled tasks and reacts to domain events without human input

actors.name: Dynamics System
actors.description: Microsoft Dynamics CRM system that manages customer data and processes business transactions

actors.name: Mobile app
actors.description: A mobile application that allows customers to browse products, place orders, and track deliveries from their smartphones

actors.name: Support Agent
actors.description: Internal staff member who assists customers and resolves issues on their behalf

actors.name: Manager
actors.description: Business stakeholder who reviews reports, approves exceptions, and sets operational policies

events.name: Order Placed
events.description: A new order has been successfully submitted and is awaiting fulfilment

events.name: Order Cancelled
events.description: An existing order has been voided and no further processing will occur

events.name: Payment Processed
events.description: A financial transaction has been completed and funds have been captured

events.name: Stock Updated
events.description: Inventory levels for one or more products have changed

events.name: Account Registered
events.description: A new customer account has been created and is ready for use

events.name: Request Approved
events.description: A pending action requiring authorisation has been granted and will now proceed

events.name: Refund Issued
events.description: Funds have been returned to the customer and the associated payment has been marked as refunded

policies.name: Order Validation Policy
policies.description: An order may only be confirmed when all requested products are in stock and payment authorisation succeeds

policies.name: Payment Authorization Policy
policies.description: Payments above a configurable threshold require a secondary verification step before capture

policies.name: Low Stock Alert Policy
policies.description: When inventory for any product falls below its reorder threshold, a replenishment command is automatically triggered

policies.name: Refund Eligibility Policy
policies.description: Refunds may only be issued within 30 days of the original payment and only for orders that have been fully delivered

policies.name: Discount Application Policy
policies.description: Promotional discounts are applied automatically when a customer's basket meets the qualifying criteria defined in the active campaign
